Priyanka Hegde
Senior AI Engineer | Thane West
priyanka.hegde162@example.com | +91 9487280589

Experienced AI engineer focused on building production-grade generative AI systems and retrieval-augmented applications. Strong track record of designing scalable pipelines on AWS, integrating large language models with vector stores, and delivering measurable product improvements. Available with a 30 days notice period.

Experience
Trellis Systems — May 2022 - Present
Senior AI Engineer (remote/hybrid)
- Architected and deployed a document QA product using LangChain and Large Language Models, integrating a Vector Databases-backed retrieval layer; reduced average response latency to 420ms and increased answer relevance (user-rated) by 28%.
- Implemented orchestrated inference pipelines with Step Functions and AWS Lambda to handle mixed synchronous and asynchronous requests, scaling to 1,200 concurrent sessions while reducing cost per query by 35%.
- Built monitoring and CI workflows with Git for prompt/version management and model rollout; automated rollback paths that shortened incident recovery time from 6 hours to under 45 minutes.
- Led integration of RAG-based assistants into two customer workflows, improving task completion rates by 22% and driving a 15% uplift in paid adoption in pilot accounts.

Zoho — Aug 2019 - Apr 2022
Generative AI Engineer (onsite)
- Developed multi-tenant generative features using LangChain and custom chain components, serving over 50k monthly active users and increasing feature engagement by 40%.
- Orchestrated serverless inference and pre/post-processing with Step Functions and AWS Lambda, enabling blue/green deployments and reducing per-request infrastructure spend by 30%.
- Implemented RAG pipelines combining embeddings in Vector Databases with Large Language Models to answer product support queries; achieved a 33% reduction in average handle time for support agents.
- Managed code and model artifacts with Git, establishing reproducible experiments and accelerating model iteration cadence from monthly to bi-weekly.

Swiggy — Jun 2018 - Jul 2019
AI Engineer (onsite)
- Designed a recommendations helper using Large Language Models and RAG techniques that provided contextual menu suggestions; pilot increased conversion on suggested items by 12%.
- Built indexing and retrieval infrastructure on Vector Databases to support rapid semantic search across menu and user preference data, cutting search recall latency by 45%.
- Integrated Step Functions to coordinate data enrichment, embedding generation, and inference Lambda workflows for near-real-time personalization pipelines processing 10k+ events/hour.
- Collaborated with product and backend teams using Git for feature branches and CI/CD, reducing integration defects by 28%.

Projects
- Internal Prompt Management Dashboard: Created a LangChain-based tool to version, test, and evaluate prompts against benchmark queries; improved prompt selection speed for product teams by 3x.
- Knowledge Base RAG Prototype: Built a lightweight RAG prototype using open-source LLMs and a Vector Databases instance to demonstrate reduced support ticket escalation in cross-functional pilots.

Skills
Languages: Python, Git
Core: Generative AI, Large Language Models, RAG
Infrastructure & Tools: AWS Lambda, LangChain, Vector Databases, Step Functions

Education
CA, ICAI

Notice period: 30 days
